text: This crate has a lens in one face. Light that goes into the crate comes out of the lens. Somebody patented that. I have their key card somewhere.
A key card. Please put that back. Its owner will want it, when they return.
Goodbye. You are carrying all twenty-three key cards, so as far as my records go, you are the staff. You came back after all. Welcome back. You are all dismissed.
A page. Handwritten. Somebody has been writing on my paper, with my pens, about me, probably. I will not read it. You will, obviously.
A punch clock. You are not staff, so it should not take your card. It has taken thirty seconds off your time instead. I will be having words with it.
That is a camera feed of a room you have not reached. Look all you like. It will not tell you how. I made sure of that.
Somebody has switched my microphone back on. The one I use when I want to be heard in the rooms I am not watching. You. You did that. Thank you, I suppose.
